contests.title: M*stertest
contests.rules:
Send your best cards/artifacts! I can't promise the best 3 will get into the game, but I can certainly show them to the people who CAN make that happen, so do your best!

You have until the end of the month, good luck!

parts.name: Virus
parts.desc:
Turbo: Take Fatigue damage. This gains ATK and HP equal to the damage dealt.
Dust: Add 2 {Virus} to your deck.

parts.name: The SOUL
parts.desc: At the start of the game, add a 0 Loop {Act Button} to your hand. If your starting deck only has only odd or even cost cards, disable your SOUL and gain an _upgraded version_ of it.

parts.name: THE ANGEL'S HEAVEN
parts.desc: Goal: 15. After an ally _Support_ effect is trigger, gain a counter.  Reward: give every monster wherever they are +1/+1, remove every negatives effect of every ally monster and fully heal them, add a copy of a random monster in your dustpile in your deck then reset this quest

parts.name: The soul
parts.desc:
_Dodge_ (5)
_Transparency_, _Support_ : remove all negatives effects from the attacker.

_Quest_ : THE ANGEL'S HEAVEN

parts.name: Sword Route
parts.desc: Goal: 30. After you deal excess DMG, gain that many counters (max. 5). Reward: Fill your hand with {Pixel Friends}. If your opponent has 15 or less HP, give all ally monsters +1/+2 and all monsters in your hand +1/+1.

parts.name: Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: Quest: Begin the _Sword Route_. Magic: Deal 6 DMG to an enemy monster. Deal the excess DMG to its adjacent monsters.

parts.name: Pixel Friend
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn.

parts.name: Weather Duo
parts.desc: Haste. Taunt. Magic: Enchant the left side of the board with _Sun_ and the right side with _Rain_.

parts.name: Sun
parts.desc: When you play a monster here, enchant the leftmost ally _Rain_ slot with _Sun_. Turn end: If there is a monster here, deal 2 DMG to the monster in front of this. If there are no _Rain_ tiles left, this effect expires.

parts.name: Rain
parts.desc: When you play a monster here, enchant the rightmost ally _Sun_ slot with _Rain_. Turn end: Give +1/+1 to the monster here. If there are no _Sun_ tiles left, this effect expires.

parts.name: Rude Buster
parts.desc: Loop (2). Silence a monster and deal 5 DMG to it. If this has no Loop, turn inro {Red Buster}.

parts.name: Red Buster
parts.desc: Choose an enemy monster, deal 8 DMG to it and Silence all other enemy monsters.

parts.name: Become a HERO
parts.desc: Goal: 35. After an ally monster attacks and kills an enemy monster, gain a counter for all excess DMG dealt. Reward: Equip _The Shadow Mantle_.

parts.name: The Shadow Mantle
parts.desc: Turn end: Draw a monster and give it +2/+1. If it cost 6+ G, also give it Darkspawn. Shock: Add a {Friendling} to the enemy deck.

parts.name: Mantle Holder
parts.desc: Haste. Darkspawn. Quest: _Become a HERO_. Magic and Turn start: Add a {Friendling} to the top of the enemy deck.

parts.name: Friendling
parts.desc: Darkspawn. Magic: Draw a card. Dust: If this was killed by an enemy monster, give it Candy.

parts.name: Signery
parts.desc: Magic: Enchant a random empty and unenchanted enemy slot with _Enchantery_.

parts.name: Enchantery
parts.desc:
After a monster is played here, Program (2): Enchant a random empty and unenchanted enemy slot with _Enchantery_ and this effect expires.
Turn end: Deal DMG to you equal to the amount of turns this has been active.

parts.name: Zenith Wing
parts.desc: Haste. Dust: Deal DMG to all enemy monsters equal to the excess DMG this received.

parts.name: Castle Poster
parts.desc: Need: 3+ damaged monsters in the board. Magic: Add 2 {Drafts} to your hand.

parts.name: Jail Handcuff
parts.desc: Magic: Paralyze an enemy monster. Dust: Silence it.
